content.body: (re module declarations discussion today, for context)

sorry i had to leave today's meeting abruptly -- was anything else discussed after i left? any thoughts about next steps? my understanding was i was going to work on a rewrite of the proposal/spec toward a version of what oli proposed. but then i was waiting on the issue nicolo opened to see if there were any other constraints or feedback. how should we come to a conclusion about the format question?

Happy to discuss here further - I guess the point I'm making with the data is that Oli's suggestion cuts the 120ms down to 20ms. And if anything that last 20ms could be seen as an acceptable tradeoff to move forward with the string based manifest file further based on user readability, inspectability and the well-defined toolchain separation being the benefits of that. Honestly having thought about it this way I can totally get behind this framing!
